announcement: Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer - Melexis Microelectronic Integrated Systems, Sofia Job Search Search for Jobs 0 Saved Jobs Jobs Expiring Soon Search for Jobs My Profile Login Register CV Job Alerts Newsletter Career Guides Saved Jobs ( 0 ) Jobs Expiring Soon Login Register CV Job Alerts Career Guides Conferences Post a Job Recruiter Recruiters Guide Recruiters Recruiters Guide Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer Saved Save this Job Saved Save Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer Melexis Microelectronic Integrated Systems Sofia, Bulgaria Your future job We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer to join our engineering team. This role combines intricate circuit simulation and system-level analysis. You will be responsible for ensuring the robustness and performance of our mixed-signal integrated circuits and modules, from initial design simulations to final validation. The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in simulation methodologies, system analysis and planning. More specifically, you will: Define and implement the system-level verification plan to ensure full functional coverage of SoC requirements; Develop reusable models for analog blocks and create self-checking, back-to-back testbenches; Implement UVM-based testbenches for top-level, full-chip mixed-signal simulation; Integrate and verify embedded firmware within the top-level UVM environment; Analyze simulation and verification results, identify design issues, and collaborate with design engineers to resolve them; Analyze verification results and prepare comprehensive test reports; Create, run, and debug complex simulations using industry-standard simulators; Act as an interface between analog, digital, software and test development. Your profile Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or Microelectronics; 5+ years experience in mixed-signal verification; Expertise in System Verilog and UVM, experience with Verilog-AMS is a plus; Experience with scripting languages; Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in system-wide challenges; Excellent communication and teamwork abilities; Fluency in English (both written and spoken). Desirable Qualifications: Experience with standard AMS simulators (e.g., Cadence Xcelium, Synopsys VCS-AMS); Familiarity with embedded C and processor-based SoC architectures; Knowledge of specific communication protocols (e.g., SENT, SPC, SPI, I2C); Understanding of DFT (Design for Test) principles.
